title: Medico-legal Assessment
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Record the mechanism as described, and record it as the patient's description rather than as an established fact.
Examine both knees in full, since the comparison is part of the record.
Record every measurement rather than a summary, including the range in degrees and the side to side differences.
Record the negative findings explicitly, because a silence is read as an omission.
Record anything that limited the examination, and why.
Record the function in the patient's own terms and separately from your assessment of it.
